faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Domestic Longhair?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 8-15 lb (3.5-7 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Dental disease; Obesity; Chronic kidney disease (senior). Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Domestic Longhair, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
